lastTask: Fix npm EPERM error handling and cache-gating bug (Windows & Linux)
decisions: Invoke-Step (PowerShell) returns no value; success is read from $Script:Results[...].Status — single source of truth.
npm step skips gracefully when the global prefix needs elevation (Windows: under C:\Program Files + non-elevated) or is not writable (Linux: -w check on npm root -g).
Rejected the Write-Host/Out-Host workaround in favor of removing the redundant boolean return value.
risks: Windows elevation heuristic (prefix under $env:ProgramFiles) may skip npm for a rare user who has write access to Program Files without elevation.
nextActions: Commit and push the npm fix (scripts + README + context files).
Optional: verify the npm global-update path under an elevated shell.
